security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Monitor AI coding-tool usage from the Windows notification area.
bundle.longDescription: TokenTray reads the sessions already stored by your installed AI coding tools and shows usage, reset times, and connection status in one tray flyout. Monitoring is read-only and there is no login, backend, or telemetry.
